description.sub_name: 科技論文研讀與寫作方法
description.sub_ename: READING AND WRITING OF SCIENTIFIC PAPERS
description.describe_ch: 許多理工科碩、博士班學生，在閱讀與撰寫科技論文時往往見樹不見林並且不知如何下筆，主要原因在於不清楚"科技論文"的架構與邏輯，因此閱讀起來常常將重點視而不見，撰寫時亦不知應用何種方式去論述、編排及下結論。科技論文的撰寫，除了有系統地研讀高水準的論文範例以外，仍需透過不斷的練習才能使寫作技巧趨於成熟。本課程之主要目的是協助學生如何有效率的研讀與撰寫科技論文。
description.describe_eh: The first part of this course aims to guide graduate students to read scientific and technical research papers effectively, to understand the content of a research paper comprehensively, and to appreciate the structure and logic of a research paper. The second part of this course is to show graduate students how to prepare and publish a scientific paper. Writing techniques are presented for various sections of an article, including abstract, introduction, methods of approach, results and discussion, conclusions, references, acknowledgements, etc.
